explication: FastGPT is an AI-agent building platform: users configure applications and visual workflows, connect skills and knowledge sources, then run applications and inspect their results. Its documented capabilities span workflow orchestration, model calls, knowledge ingestion and retrieval, tool integrations, evaluation, and operational chat logs. The graph highlights those product stages and the Mongo/Redis service layer. README-described capabilities are included, but several connections are unverified because their implementation was not sampled; those edges are dashed rather than asserted as inspected call paths.
